retrieval: Up to4 exact/STRING-neighbor targets per allowed source; max32 tokens. Entire recipient family and outer family excluded. Differentiable context-conditioned attention over measured gene-level effects. Remove each response donor own-gene coordinate. Family/source/candidate-normalized prior.
architecture: Attention79->32->1; per-gene shared decoder51->64->32->2,16 STRING output-gene and16 target coordinates,4 control rank coordinates. All common measured genes, no selected low-rank response decoder. Zero-initial residual head, bounded +/-0.5 log2FC correction; outside modeled/support coordinates exact V24 fallback.
V35: Family-balanced summary LFC MSE+0.2 MAE with small residual penalty. Fit target hash80%, source-validation target20%; select among8 epochs using source-validation MSE. Whole-family cross-fitted V24 as baseline for every fitting recipient.
V36: Warm-start its matching V35 model. Eight pairs of disjoint treated populations and matched-lane control populations per training source target. Population LFC consistency supervision weighted by replicate agreement; log-CV2 response head and source NTC variance/dropout features. Summary and population objectives balanced; no observed treated mean/variance at inference.
negative_controls: retrieved response identities shuffled within source at inference
counts: V35 mean, V36 mean with unchanged V24 residual10 emitter, V36 learned gene-wise empirical-residual weights0.05..0.25 (Poisson0.65 unchanged), exact libraries and dual mean moments. Same fixed first4 public cases/context plus5 nulls as V34;200-cell D1 descriptive.
count_guards: Family-balanced raw metrics; expression error no more than2% worse; fidelity drop<=0.02; PDS drop<=0.02; null calls no worse than V24. Do not interpret null fidelity as treatment recovery.
release: User explicitly requests a new package: select best experimental candidate by equal-study mean MSE, subject to count guards when feasible. If no strict improvement passes, label package exploratory/unconfirmed, preserve V24 as champion, do not call it better and do not open reserve. No upload or push.
validation_scope: Previously spent public families and cases, exploratory; no official private anchors or promised leaderboard improvement. D3 untouched.

literature.idea: Learn context-dependent retrieval, not fixed semantic averaging; independently adapted with STRING instead of GenePT.
Independent population views distinguish repeatable effects from sampling variation; moment-summary adaptation, not full author set encoder or reproduction.
